title: North Dakota Century Code Chapter 34-06 - Minimum Wages and Hours
verified_how: fetched the register's Title 34 chapter index (https://ndlegis.gov/cencode/t34.html): title 'Title 34 - Labor and Employment', chapter row '34-06' with name 'Minimum Wages and Hours' and no '[Repealed]' marker (sibling chapters 34-04, 34-10 and 34-16 do carry that marker, so the marker is in use on this page); then fetched the chapter's own section index https://ndlegis.gov/cencode/t34c06.html, which lists sections from 34-06-01. Currency taken from the Century Code landing page: '07/01/25 UPDATE: All statutory changes approved by the 69th Legislative Assembly are now reflected on this website'.
notes: The substantive wage-rate, overtime and hours chapter; the Labor Commissioner sets the minimum wage rate by rule under it. The companion enforcement chapter is N.D.C.C. ch. 34-14 (Wage Collection), and employer/employee pay obligations also appear in ch. 34-02 (Obligations of Employer and Employee); both were verified as in force on the same index page but are not listed separately because only one statute per topic is recorded.
